chapter: Jelly Roll Morton and Tempo Music
title: Cabaret singers; meeting Jelly Roll Morton in 1938 and writing songs with him
summary: Carew describes cabaret singers, then reads of Morton and Tony Jackson in a paper, visits him in Washington, proposes reviving Joplin and instead ends up writing words for Morton's songs.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
